# cloudless_storage (Resource)

A storage volume on a Fluence cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudless_storage" "data" {
  cluster_id   = data.cloudless_cluster.main.id
  name         = "data"
  storage_type = "NVME"
  volume_gb    = 200
  replicated   = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `replicated` (Boolean)
- `storage_type` (String)
- `volume_gb` (Number) Volume size in GB. In-place resizes via PATCH; the operation may be disruptive (VM restart, data migration) — see provider docs.

### Optional

- `image_id` (String) Catalog image this disk is built from; presence makes it a boot disk. See the cloudless_default_image data source.

### Read-Only

- `attached_vm_ids` (List of String) VMs this disk is attached to.
- `boot_mode` (String) Firmware the image boots with (BIOS or EFI).
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
